details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** Its controller uses Fortitude defense when player-controlled; a player attacking it rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Strike whoever bars the rider's route, then spend its Maneuver on straight-line movement. It cannot carry someone through an occupied square.

**Encounter and conversation:** It waits at a ruined milestone for a rider carrying the correct burial token.

**Habitat:** Crypt; burial ground; ruined settlement · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Undead 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/bestiary/summons/skeleton-horse.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-skeleton-horse


**Category:** Undead · **Role:** Displacer · **CV:** 15

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 2/4/6

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.3

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.000, O=3.000. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [grave gallop](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/monster-abilities/grave-gallop.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
